note: geometry measured on PEMM00 from a live frame of cn.flytalk.tetris.nearme.gamecenter (2026-10-12, re-measured). Cells are classified by the fraction of a cell's pixels above the HSV thresholds (hsv.min_occupancy), not by a centre sample: a piece the game is animating between two rows covers ~40% of each of them.

measured.source: screencap 720x1600; the board's own edges measured 2026-10-12: the outer background plateaus at mean brightness 47.3 and steps to >=67 inside the board at x=30, x=450, y=380, y=1235 (previously recorded as x[35,465] y[320,1180], which was 60 px high in y - about 1.4 rows - and was taken from a descriptive answer rather than measured)
measured.verified_by: 39x39 px blocks on a 42.5 px pitch, the bottom-most block ending at y=1234 against the declared bottom 1235; the falling piece in skills/tetris/samples/session-0001.png is read as a piece (tests/unit/reflex/test_board_alignment.py)

mechanics.note: The game can switch the drop direction mid-session (切换掉落方向) and defines custom shapes (定义方块). gravity_options is the axis set this skill can play and must match simulator.GRAVITIES; shapes is the app's custom shape set as 0/1 bitmaps, empty until a live session records it - the simulator accepts any mask, so nothing needs recompiling when it is filled in.
